extDescription.message: Fancy text anywhere you type. Right-click selected text to restyle it in 140+ fonts like 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝 and ⓑⓤⓑⓑⓛⓔ. Private & offline.

cmdApplyLast.message: Apply your last-used style to the selected text

toastCopied.description: In-page notice, shown after the brand name.

toastCopiedPaste.message: This field can't be changed directly. Copied instead — press Ctrl+V (⌘V) to paste.

inputPlaceholder.message: Type or paste your text here…

insertHint.message: Tip: ↵ or Shift+Enter inserts a style straight into the page.

sampleText.description: Preview text shown when the input is empty.

popupCopyFailed.message: Couldn't copy — select the preview and press Ctrl+C.

copyVerb.description: Screen-reader prefix before a style name on each popup row.

insertStyleLabel.message: Insert in $1 style into the page

fragileHint.message: Uses rare characters that may not display on every device

favoritesEmpty.message: No favorites yet. Tap ☆ on any style to pin it here and in the right-click menu.

tipRightClick.message: Tip: select text on any page, right-click → FancyTextPro.

tipPlainKeywords.message: Tip: keep names and hashtags plain — styled letters aren't searchable or screen-reader friendly.

tipShortcut.message: Tip: $1 re-applies your last style to selected text.

tipFavorites.message: Tip: star ☆ your go-to styles to pin them to the right-click menu.

optMenuAction.message: When you pick a style for selected text

optMenuReplace.message: Replace it in place when the text is editable (otherwise copy)

optMenuRecent.message: Show recently used styles in the menu

optShortcutsChrome.message: You can change these on Chrome’s extension shortcuts page.

optShortcutsFirefox.message: To change these, open about:addons → ⚙ → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

optPrivacy.message: FancyTextPro converts text entirely on your device. It sends nothing anywhere, has no analytics or tracking, and only reads a page when you use it there. Favorites and settings stay in your browser.

optClearConfirm.message: Clear all favorites and recently used styles?

welcomeLead.message: Fancy text anywhere you type: social posts, bios, chats and comments.

welcomeTryBody.message: Select some of the text below, right-click it and choose FancyTextPro.

welcomeDemoText.message: Hello! Select me, then right-click → FancyTextPro → pick a style.

welcomeStep1Body.message: Pick a style from the FancyTextPro menu. Editable text is replaced in place; anything else is copied. Ctrl+Z undoes it.

welcomeStep2Body.message: Click the FancyTextPro icon (pin it from the puzzle-piece menu) to browse 140+ styles with live previews.

welcomeStep3Body.message: Starred styles appear first in the popup and in the right-click menu.
